references.anchor: # CI-STRAY-1 — Hunt the remaining stray database connection that fails CI from inside browser-style tests
references.purpose: The card: the fault's exact signature (ReferenceError: process is not defined at pg/lib/client.js, thrown when a pooled connection closes inside a vm context with no Node process global), the acceptance bar, and the guardrails (no suppression, no quarantine, no whole-pool move).

The ui project definition (vmThreads pool, jsdom) whose contexts have no process global; the ui-db forks project beside it is the established pattern for suites that genuinely need a real database while rendering.

references.anchor: const budget=Number(args[1]);if(budget<1||budget>180)throw Error('CI feedback budget must be 1–180 seconds; profile/split growing cohorts rather than raising it.');
references.purpose: The phase runner every CI unit shard step runs under (the workflow's shard step is ci-phase --budget-seconds 180 -- npx vitest run --shard=N/3 against a throwaway Postgres service): the hunt must reproduce in that shape, in a runner-shaped environment, with connection logging on. (The workflow file itself cannot be a packet reference — the packet path guard refuses dot-directory paths; recorded in the PR.)

risk: test infrastructure only — no production code, no schema, no migrations. The failure mode being hunted is an unhandled error that fails CI despite all tests passing; the fix must never suppress the error report, mark it expected, or skip/quarantine a test. A census workflow added for the hunt is dispatch-only and must not change the required ci workflow's behaviour.
sequence: Local hunt first (done 2026-11-03 night, recorded in PR #841): per-file connection census of all 87 ui-project files against a logging Postgres — zero connections; full ui project serial run — clean; exact CI shard 2/3 invocation locally and on a clean bench — zero unhandled errors. The fault did not reproduce anywhere off GitHub's runners (5 of 5 clean) and fired 4 of 4 times in GitHub Actions.

Route decision (2026-11-04, recorded on the card): the in-Actions census rides the EXISTING ci workflow — it already triggers on pull_request and workflow_dispatch, so no new workflow file is needed and the execution-packet guard (scripts/work-packet.mjs safePath, which refuses dot-directory paths) is NOT amended and NOT bypassed. The census instruments live entirely in packetable paths: tests/stray-census.setup.ts (per-worker pg connect patch: creating stack + active test file, close logging, still-open report at file teardown), scripts/stray-census-global.mjs (globalSetup sampler polling pg_stat_activity on the CI database), and the wiring in vitest.config.mts. The instruments are inert unless STRAY_CENSUS=1 or the scripts/stray-census.ACTIVE marker exists; the marker exists only on the diagnostic branch and is never merged to main.

Run the census in Actions on the diagnostic branch (PR trigger, then workflow_dispatch repeats at the same head as needed) and convict the opener from the census output itself: the CONNECT record whose stack and file opened the connection that later closes inside an innocent ui file's window.

Fix at the source in the owning suite: close the client/pool in teardown, or move the suite to the ui-db pattern if it genuinely needs a real database. No error suppression anywhere. The fix lands on its own branch from main, with the census tooling included in its permanent, inert-by-default form (no ACTIVE marker).

Acceptance: three consecutive green ci runs at the same head on the fix branch, each including unit tests (2/3) with zero unhandled errors; then PR #837 refreshes onto the new main and passes a fresh push-triggered ci at its new exact head.
